[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
John was born in 1717. He is the son of [[Glasgow-1073|John Glasgow]] and [[Scott-40313|Margaret Scott]].
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1073]] is assessed at 99% (proved). John’s 22 September 1717 Kirkland entry names Revd Mr John Glasgow, minister, and Margaret Scot; the exact office and couple resolve the father even with another John child in 1713.

This 1717 child’s father, without merging him with the 1713 child or assuming either adult fate.

Next useful test: Compare the 1713 and 1717 originals and seek burial evidence before merging same-name children.

Source basis already held: [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F3586332&tab=this Findmypast, Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564-1929: John Glasgow, 22 Sep 1717, record SCOT/OPR/BAP/3586332].
